text:
Marta: Heads-up — planning lyra13b enablement TOMORROW 10:00 UTC. Need final fallback slotting, pin windows, and rollback thresholds.
Owen: Timeline acked. My plan: canary 10% -> 25% -> 50% over 30m intervals. Rollback if p95 latency spikes > 40% or error rate > 1.5% for 5m.
Priya: Agree on thresholds. Also add QA perf checks for generation-quality regression (BLEU/ROUGE) on the canonical prompt set before 50%.
Marta: Safety slots: reserve two fallback slots in catalog for lyra13b variants. Proposed order:
```
1) lyra13b-quant-v1
2) lyra13b-8bit-v2
3) lyra13b-fp16-v1
4) base-text-7b
```
Owen: LGTM but swap positions 2 & 3 — 8bit has shown worse hallucination rate in evals.
Kai: Note: dedicated pool capacity at 10:00 UTC will be limited in us-west-2 (maintenance). Can we set regional fallback to eu-west-1 for that window?
Marta: Yes — change window policy: allow region-failover to eu-west-1 for 10:00-11:30 UTC. Add annotation in release notes.
Deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: lyra13b -> 10% traffic -> target clusters: us-east-1, us-west-2
Deploy-bot: Canary started (id: canary-3987654322-1)
SRE-bot: Alert policy bound: latency-p95-alert -> notify #eng-oncall and #eng-releases. Escalation: if triggered twice within 15m, auto-pause canary.
Priya: For pinning: add temporary pin for beta-users route /chat/beta to keep lyra13b pinned until 14:00 UTC. Script:
```
redwoodctl catalog pin --route /chat/beta --model lyra13b:quant-v1 --until 2026-03-20T14:00:00Z
```
Marta: Rollback plan: on auto-pause or manual rollback -> promote fallback chain by +1 slot, drain lyra tasks with 5m grace, revert pin lists. Notifying customers: update status page and add short changelog entry.
Owen: Who's on rollback duties? I'll take first 30m. Kai covers if it stretches past the hour.
Priya: I'll prepare the regression diff and screenshots for the release notes now.
Marta: Final ask — double-check canary telemetry tags include `model:lyra13b`, `variant`, `quantization` and `rollout_stage`. Also add `safety_slot` tag for any fallback event.
Deploy-bot: Canary reached 25% -> running perf checks (latency, errors, quality sampling).
SRE-bot: No alerts so far. Perf p95 within baseline +12% (below threshold).
Owen: Proceed to 50% after QA sample completes (I'll post results in 5m).
Priya: QA sampling shows minor drop in ROUGE (-1.2) on convo prompts — acceptable. No safety-gate trigger.
Deploy-bot: Canary completed 50% -> ready for full enable decision.
Marta: Green light from me. Proceed to full enable at 10:45 UTC if no new alerts. Remember to add the fallback mapping to release notes and push the pin script to infra repo.
Kai: Confirmed — I updated infra PR with fallback ordering and regional exemptions for maintenance window.
Marta: Thanks team. Will post a short roll-call in #customer-success before the cutover and follow-up in #eng-releases with final timestamps and rollback ownership.
Deploy-bot: Full enable scheduled for 3987657920 (2026-03-20T10:45:20Z) — will execute unless paused.
